render_note: The page is a 100 dpi greyscale scan (834 x 1035 pixels over 600 x 745 points); the 100 dpi render is one render pixel per scan pixel. Picks were read from the gridded copy bisht-fig1-100dpi.png and its enlargements, which share pixel coordinates.

north.evidence: Fig. 1 (PDF p. 47, printed p. 33), upper right: a compass rose on a long stem with an arrowhead and the letter 'N' above it; no 'true' or 'magnetic' wording on the figure or in the caption 'Fig.1 Banawali Excavations'.
north.survey_year_evidence: Not stated on the figure; Banawali was excavated by the ASI from 1974 onward and the article appeared in Puratattva 29 (1998-99).

scale.evidence: Scale bar at top centre labelled '50 0 50 meters'. The left segment is divided into five 10 m parts by ticks at x 250.5, 262, 274.5, 286, 299.5 and 311; the 0 tick is at 311 and the right 50 tick at 369.5. Picks v1 took the tick at 299.5 as 0, which made all lengths 23 per cent too long; the IAR 1987-88 print of the same drawing at the same page scale (50 m = 60.5 px) confirms the corrected reading.

lines.identification: Hatched band drawn as the southern outer fortification enclosing the 'ACROPOLIS' and 'LOWER TOWN' on Fig. 1 (legend: Harappan defences, hatched where not exposed); band centre fitted.
Southern straight stretch of the western outer fortification, hatched band at x about 79 on Fig. 1; band centre fitted.
Northern stretch of the western outer fortification, slanting from the NW corner bastion to the bend near y 320 on Fig. 1; band centre fitted.
Northern outer fortification between the NW corner bastion and the NE corner on Fig. 1, passing the bastion at x 300; band centre fitted.
Eastern outer fortification with excavated (black) stretches, the entrance with 'b b DRAIN cum TIE WALL', 'STEPS' and the 'MOAT' outside, on Fig. 1; band centre through the black stretches fitted.
Double-dashed street running from the bastion of the northern outer wall at x 300 south toward the 'b.b. DRAIN RAMP' of the acropolis on Fig. 1; western line fitted.
